mechanism: Perp funding rate and quarterly-futures basis are two independent market estimates of annualized cost-of-carry. disagreement = funding_ann_pct - basis_near_ann. When disagreement is extreme (>= frozen q90 or <= frozen q10, per-symbol), fade the disagreement: bet basis converges toward funding. RICH (funding >> basis) -> LONG quarterly / SHORT perp. CHEAP (funding << basis, deeply negative funding = bear/de-risking regime) -> SHORT quarterly / LONG perp.
source_report: reports/edge_discovery/alpha_hunt_2026-08-30/w4_calendar_basis/REPORT.md (mechanism M7, rank 1 in the ranked table, the report's own headline/PROMISING finding)
not_a_repackaging_of_basis_level_check: Source report verified corr(disagreement, basis_ann) = 0.49-0.52 only (moderate, not redundant); CHEAP-disagreement entries have basis_near_ann at entry statistically indistinguishable from whole-sample median (only 16-23% would qualify under M1's own top-quintile basis-extremity test), while funding_ann_pct is genuinely distinct (median -2.2%/-2.4% vs whole-sample +4.9%/+5.5%). Reused here without re-deriving -- this is read-only evidence from the source report, not re-verified independently in this implementation.

frozen_horizon_choice.why_k30d_not_k14d: k30d is the ONLY horizon in the source report where BOTH BTC and ETH clear BOTH cost tiers simultaneously: BTC net_base(14bps)=+33.2bps/net_stress(28bps)=+19.2bps; ETH net_base=+30.3bps/net_stress=+16.3bps. At k14d, BTC fails the stress-cost tier (net_stress=-6.3bps) -- only ETH clears both tiers at k14d (net_base=+15.3/net_stress=+1.3, barely). k30d is also the horizon the registry's pre-existing worst_episode_bps values (-111.8 BTC / -106.6 ETH) were already recorded against, so freezing k30d keeps this implementation consistent with those numbers rather than silently redefining them.
frozen_horizon_choice.tradeoff_honestly_flagged: k30d has a thinner true-independent-N than k14d after decluster: BTC n=18 (k30d) vs n=24 (k14d); ETH n=15 (k30d) vs n=25 (k14d). Also: the source report's explicit year-by-year stability breakdown ('positive every year 2024-26') is shown at k7d in the report's prose, not independently broken out at k30d -- the ranked-table row states 'positive every year 2024-26 (both symbols)' for the M7 mechanism as a whole (across the 15-24 N range spanning k14d-k30d), but this is not a k30d-specific year-by-year confirmation. Treated as inferred, not independently verified at k30d specifically.

frozen_spec.funding_ann_pct: funding_rate_daily_mean * 3 * 365 * 100.0 (8h funding periods -> 3/day -> annualized, as percent; identical formula to source report's build_panel.py)
frozen_spec.near_contract_selection: smallest positive dte among quarterly contracts trading on that date (causal, no lookahead)
frozen_spec.eligibility_filter: near_dte >= 7 (MIN_DTE floor, identical to source report's pitfall #4 guard against annualized-basis blowup near expiry)
frozen_spec.thresholds_are_frozen_not_refit: These are the exact train-fit (first 60% chronological split) decile thresholds reported in the source report's M7 section. This implementation NEVER recomputes them from live/incoming data -- doing so on the live feed's short (~2 month) history window would be severe data-snooping on a tiny sample. Any threshold change requires a new alpha_id (_V2), per the registry's own no-retroactive-edit rule.
frozen_spec.decluster_pass_1_episode_contiguity: An entry only fires on the FIRST day of a contiguous RICH or CHEAP run (regime label change vs previous eligible day, or a calendar gap, starts a new episode) -- replicates source report's build_episodes()/episode_entries().
frozen_spec.decluster_pass_2_nonoverlap: An episode-start candidate is only kept if it starts >= FROZEN_HORIZON_DAYS (30) after the previously KEPT entry for the SAME symbol -- replicates source report's nonoverlap_filter() (the fix for the Aug-Sep 2024 9-overlapping-episodes bug documented in the source report's 'Two new pitfalls' section). Recomputed deterministically from full history on every run (no external state needed for correctness; idempotency is handled separately by the runner's ledger dedup on (date, symbol)).

perp_price_leg_deviation.issue: The source report's basis calculation used data/derivatives_backfill/um_klines_1d/{BTC,ETH}USDT_1d.parquet (daily perp kline close) for the perp price. CONFIRMED STALE: max_date=2026-06-30, mtime 2026-07-17 -- not updated since.
perp_price_leg_deviation.resolution: This implementation substitutes the live mark_price field from the SAME derivatives_raw open_interest stream used for funding_rate (both come from the same Binance premiumIndex REST poll) -- daily-aggregated as the LAST observed mark_price within the calendar day, as a causal proxy for a daily perp close.
perp_price_leg_deviation.caveat_honestly_flagged: mark_price is not bit-identical to the perp kline close used in the original discovery panel (mark price is an index-weighted fair-value estimate, not the literal last traded price) -- in practice these are typically within a few bps of each other, but this substitution has NOT been separately backtested or re-validated against the original discovery methodology. This is a live-data-availability necessitated deviation, not a re-derivation of the mechanism.

data_freshness_investigation.both_legs_summary: Both legs (funding AND quarterly basis) are genuinely live as of 2026-08-31 -- data_live: true in the registry. The perp price sub-leg required a substitution (documented above) because its original discovery-time source is stale.

execution_notes: No simulated fills in this V1. This is signal generation ONLY: the runner logs (date, symbol, regime, direction, disagreement, basis_near_ann, funding_ann_pct, near_dte) per decluster-selected entry. No PnL is computed, no forward return is measured, no order of any kind (real or simulated) is ever sent.
execution_blocked_reason: No multi-leg mismatch safety simulator exists yet -- Mode A signal only, do not build Mode B for this alpha without that simulator. This mechanism is inherently 2-leg (perp + quarterly future), and the registry's own status vocabulary reserves EXECUTION_SHADOW (Mode B, simulated fills) for alphas that have passed that safety gate; this alpha has not, and building it was explicitly out of scope for this task.
